name: Morgana Ascendant
title: The Unified Valkyrie
origin: The Eternal Void (Rebirth of the Ebon Line)
description: The perfect union of Cursed Flesh and Luminous Spirit. She no longer fears the darkness; she commands it. A god-tier combatant capable of shifting between total destruction and absolute protection.

passive.name: Harmonic Singularity
passive.description: Attacks in Eclipse mode apply Shadow Burn. Attacks in Solstice mode heal the party. Swapping modes grants 'Resonance' which doubles the effect of the next skill.

skills.name: Valkyrie Shift
skills.description: Swap between Eclipse and Solstice stances. Does not consume an action once per turn.

skills.name: Void Calamity
skills.description: [Eclipse] Deals 3.0x damage to all enemies. [Solstice] Grants the party 'Void Shield' (Absorbs 50% damage for 2 turns).

skills.name: Final Resonance
skills.description: The Ultimate move. Summons all 12 feathers. Deals True Damage and fully restores the party's HP/MP. Ends the current stance and returns to Neutral.
